claim: On July 24, 2001, the Port Authority entered into 99-year net leases for World Trade Center Towers 1, 2, 4, and 5 with entities established by Silverstein Properties — 49 days before the September 11 attacks.

sources.label: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey — 2007 Financial Statements, World Trade Center net leases
sources.quote: On July 24, 2001, the Port Authority entered into net leases with respect to One, Two, Four and Five World Trade Center

sources.label: Snopes — “Did a WTC Leaseholder Buy Terrorism Insurance Just Before 9/11?” (fact-check)
Wikipedia — Larry Silverstein
sources.quote: he signed the lease on July 24, 2001

sources.label: Haley Press / @strategichaley, Instagram reel DVOtv6QCTFf (Feb 26, 2026) — surfacing source

notes: Verified against the Port Authority's 2007 financial statement. July 24 to September 11, 2001 is 49 days. The lease timing is documented; the record makes no inference about foreknowledge.
